details: PCB 96.5 x 62 + 20 mm wiring bay + screw towers
26.5 mm tall block, draft for mould release
1.2 mm tongue on the rim for the gasket
4 × Ø8 towers for ST3.5 screws, tied to the walls with ribs
6 mm stand-offs clear the 3.3 mm solder pins
2 × M16 glands: mains in, contactor out
4 slotted ears for Ø4 screws, gusseted
Flush lid, same 1° draft, R1.5 top edge
Groove receives the tongue and a Ø1.6 TPE cord
Counterbored Ø3.7 holes, heads sit 3.5 mm deep
1.5 mm ribs (60 % of wall) stop the lid oil-canning
Tubes guide Ø3 clear-PC light pipes onto the 2 LEDs
Living cantilever + plunger presses the BOOST switch
0.4 mm raised text and the 230 V hazard symbol
Purchased + secondary parts complete the assembly
